Bad value for money. Taste is average. Korean?
Nov 2023 • Family
We went there in the middle of the day.
There were three groups including us. The other two groups were from Korea. It seemed to be a Korean restaurant.
The prices were a bit high and the taste was average. The only disappointing thing was that there were a lot of gnats-like insects flying around and a fist-sized rat running around.
It's not a cheap restaurant so I wish they'd been a bit more considerate.
I felt that it would be better to go to a restaurant in town or in a market.

Good food at reasonable prices and a view from the balcony on the first floor.
Nov 2023 • Couples
Very sweet and friendly staff.
The food tasted great and especially their Spring Roll Tower is worth tasting. You get 3 different types of spring rolls.
It is a large restaurant and it is possible to sit on the first floor where you have a view of the Han River and the Dragon Bridge. If you choose to sit on the balcony on the first floor, there is noise from the traffic, but the view is beautiful.
A good restaurant with good prices.

Hello Mr. Abhay K,

Thanks for leaving us your feedback. First of all, it is a pity to hear that you didn't have a good experience at Tre Viet. 

Our restaurant have diverse options, including vegetarian option. You can find out on our website and of course in our menu at store.

I am Jimmy, Tran, the owner and also the one who took your order, cooked and served your family with two vegan dishes, and specifically explained to you that our food are MSG-free. According to your request, none of your dishes had pepper or chili. I also gave you free 02 extra white rice for your baby, and it was really glad during our conversation. Your family finished all of the food and talked joyfully.... I really don't understand what do you mean above? I hope this is only the misunderstanding.

By the way, on behalf of Tre Viet, we apologize for your unhappy experience. Hope you and family have a nice trip in Vietnam.

Thankyou.
